title: My profile
subtitle: What the site knows about you, and what you can change.
loadFailed: Your profile could not be loaded

discord.title: Discord
discord.description: Your sign-in identity. It comes from Discord and is changed there.
discord.idHelper: This is what identifies you to the site — never your username.

displayName.title: Name on this site
displayName.description: The name others see in teams and shared screens.
displayName.helper: Left empty, your Discord username is used.
displayName.failed: The name could not be saved

riot.title: Riot account
riot.description: It unlocks your personal statistics and attaches you to the teams expecting you.
riot.pendingExplanation: Your Riot ID is saved, but we could not confirm it with Riot yet. Nothing is lost: try again later, or check what you typed.

link.title: Link a Riot account
link.searchHelper: Suggestions come from matches we already collected, not from Riot: their API cannot search by partial username.
link.noSuggestionDescription: That is expected while few matches have been collected. Enter your full Riot ID below.
link.exactHelper: As the game client shows it, with the # and the tag.
link.malformed: Exactly one # is required, with text on both sides.
link.confirmDescription: Check before confirming: the linked account determines all your statistics.
link.conflict: This Riot account is already linked to another user.
link.notFound: Riot does not know this Riot ID.

change.title: Change Riot account
change.description: The current account will be replaced. Read the consequences before confirming.
change.statsReset: Your personal statistics start over from zero: the matches already collected stay attached to the previous account.
change.unknownConsequences: The core detailed no consequence for this change. It is still possible, but without those details.
change.noUnlink: There is no button to unlink an account: it would leave the teams referencing you with nobody. Changing replaces it.
change.ingestRestarted: A new collection of your matches starts.
change.rosterSlotsToClaim: Roster seats are waiting for this account: they will be attached to it.

ingest.title: Collection in progress
ingest.unavailable: Collection progress is unavailable: the Riot connector is not answering. No data is lost, only this information is missing.
